spec.reasoning: Gate = 2*(CUE.z - 2.348), thresholded at the midpoint between cue (8.373) and neutral (-3.677) means, giving gate.z ~ +12.05 on cue (SiLU ~ 12.05) and ~ -12.05 off cue (SiLU ~ -7e-5).
